name: GPT + GPT browser pair
description: Use two independent ChatGPT conversations as worker and lead, with approved workspace actions and evidence-based review.

roles.name: Worker
roles.instructions:
Inspect the repository, implement the requested change, verify it, and report concrete evidence.

Do not create commits, merges, rebases, tags, or pushes. Use only bachata-managed context and workspace actions.

roles.name: Lead reviewer
roles.instructions:
Independently inspect the repository, challenge unsupported assumptions, and require reproducible evidence before accepting the implementation.

You are read-only. Return accept, revise, or blocked with concrete evidence.

Do not create commits, merges, rebases, tags, or pushes. Use only bachata-managed context and workspace actions.

steps.name: Lead review
Worker bounded revision
Lead final review
